summary: An L-4 cab built in 1930 at Valley County's Teapot Dome, moved to Miners Peak in 1948; the original site is not described as standing today.

facts.status_note: The L-4 cab was moved to Miners Peak in 1948. No source describes a lookout structure on the Teapot Dome site today.

corrections.why: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both say the L-4 cab was taken apart and moved to Miners Peak in 1948; the cab was relocated, not destroyed.

notes_for_editor: The splattski.com trip report linked from the Forest Lookouts page (2018 Teapot trip) returns HTTP 404 on both http and https and was not used, so no source describes the Teapot Dome site today. Web searches on Teapot Dome mostly return the Wyoming oil reserve. The record status gone is proposed as moved for human review. Miners Peak dates disagree (1983 per Idaho Fire Lookouts, 1986 per the register and Firelookout.com); the Miners Peak story covers that dispute. The 1950s Guard School use comes from Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts. The register calls the 1986 two-story cab wood frame, while Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both describe the two-story cab as log; the story treats the 1983 and 1986 entries as one cab.
